facts.fact: The recitals cite law no. 30-2019 of 10 October 2019 creating the national agency for information systems security (ANSSI) and decree no. 2022-1944 of 30 December 2022 approving its statutes; the text also has ANSSI assess and co-sign security homologation of e-invoicing terminals and software.
facts.system: Agence nationale de sécurité des systèmes d'information (ANSSI)

systems.system: Agence nationale de sécurité des systèmes d'information (ANSSI)

note: Cites decree 2025-512 on a critical information infrastructure regime but states no designation or reporting duty; no incident or figures.
